title: Server-side allow-list validation
summary: Enforce the same generated privacy allow-list at the remote service boundary.
produces: Server validation against the generated shareable-field mapping

conditions: Client and server consume the same generated mapping.
An unknown envelope version is not rejected solely because its version is new.
completion.summary: Athenaeum now enforces the shared generated privacy allow-list at blob upload while preserving opaque transport and tolerating newer envelope versions.
evidence: PR #1176 and server/test/athenaeum_app_test.dart prove non-shareable record fields and unknown record kinds receive 422 and are not stored, while opaque non-envelope bytes remain byte-identical.

server/lib/src/athenaeum_app.dart directly calls compendium_core's validateShareableRecordBody; packages/compendium_core/test/sync/wire_mapping_test.dart proves the generated mapping is fresh and covers real archive paths.

server/test/athenaeum_app_test.dart proves a shareable v99 known-kind blob is accepted while v99 non-shareable and unknown-kind envelopes are rejected, so a new version is not rejected solely for being new.
